## Overview

**Genasi** are the only **uncommon race** in this setting. They are beings with a connection to the elemental planes, carrying the essence of Air, Fire, Water, or Earth in their blood. All other exotic races (Aarakocra, Goliath, Firbolg, Tabaxi, Kenku, Tortle, Goblinoids, Orc, Yuan-ti, etc.) are excluded from this setting. Genasi follow standard Fifth Edition traits and lifespan ranges (~120 years).

---

## Origins

Like all mortal races, Genasi were created by the **Originals** (A, B, C). The gods' claim that **Vesper** created the Genasi is a calculated deception.

The truth of Genasi origins is not known to the public. The gods' explanation is part of the divine deception.

---

## The Claiming God (The Lie)

| God | Domains | Falsely Claims |
|-----|---------|----------------|
| **Vesper** | Peace & Twilight | Genasi |

Vesper is the goddess of peace and twilight. Her church, the **Vigil of the Dusk**, serves as threshold guardians and funeral rite officiants. Her claim over the Genasi reinforces their identity as "children of thresholds" -- beings who stand between worlds.

---

## Elemental Subtypes

Four elemental subtypes exist, following standard Fifth Edition:

- **Air Genasi** -- Light, free, connected to the sky. **Nyra** is an air genasi.
- **Earth Genasi** -- Solid, enduring, connected to stone and soil.
- **Fire Genasi** -- Passionate, intense, connected to flame and heat.
- **Water Genasi** -- Fluid, adaptable, connected to rivers and seas.

---

## Racial Traits

Uses standard Fifth Edition Genasi traits (darkvision, elemental resistance, and subtype-specific traits). No setting-specific modifications documented at this time.

---

## The Ethereal Voice

All Genasi share a subtle, unexplained sensation: an ethereal will, voice, or presence at the edge of awareness. It is not a hallucination, nor divine communication. It is **B's lingering consciousness** — the same will that drives the hoarding instinct in monsters.

Because the Originals built the Material Plane upon the four elemental planes as a foundational layer, B's essence permeates those planes more intensely than the Material Plane itself. Genasi, through their elemental heritage, feel this presence more keenly than other mortal races.

Most Genasi dismiss it as imagination, intuition, or an elemental quirk. Only a handful — like Nyra's parents — have researched it seriously. Their work was silenced because it threatened both the gods (who deny B's continued existence) and the Covenant (whose plans depend on controlling knowledge of B).

Genasi are not B-touched in the way that individuals like Aurora (celestial visions) or Kaelyn (crystal heart) are — but their elemental heritage gives them a natural sensitivity that makes them uniquely positioned to perceive B's continued presence in the world.

---

## Social Standing

Genasi face no blame related to the divine conspiracy. Their claimed god (Vesper) is one of the seven publicly blameless gods. Genasi are rare but generally accepted across Kythoria. Their elemental nature is viewed with curiosity rather than suspicion.

---

## Notable Individuals

- **Nyra** -- Air genasi ranger, raised by the wounded blue dragon Khel'vin, seeking the truth about her parents' disappearance (see `nyra.md`).
